tools.name: authflow_create_resource
tools.title: Create an unpublished MCP draft
tools.description: Create a free or paid draft. No Stripe account is needed for a draft or free MCP. Gateway metering is the default, and every tool of a paid gateway-metered MCP starts at one credit per call. Free and gateway-metered origins need no key; only paid origin_reported needs direct secret-store delivery. Keys never appear in tool messages. metering_mode is gateway_metered or origin_reported. Per-tool access, credits, and limits are resource tools, not resource fields, and change without republishing.

tools.name: authflow_disable_resource
tools.title: Disable an MCP
tools.description: Disable the MCP so the gateway stops serving it. This clears its verification, so publishing it again needs a new authflow_verify_resource. Confirm with the owner first.

tools.name: authflow_doctor
tools.title: Check MCP health
tools.description: Run live, read-only health checks for one MCP (slug) or the whole workspace. It never changes Authflow state. Run it before authflow_verify_resource and authflow_publish_resource, after DNS or deployment changes, and first whenever anything looks broken. overall says whether anything needs doing and next_action names the check to fix first; every failing check names who fixes it (agent, owner or authflow), the exact tool and arguments, and a documentation section.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to check; defaults to the workspace this client is authorized for.

slug.description: The MCP to check. Omit to check every MCP in the workspace, up to 20.

groups.description: Comma-separated subset of rail, resource, domain, origin, billing, clients. Omit for the defaults, which suit the target.

depth.description: quick (the default) or full, which adds the origin conformance probe without recording a verification (needs slug).

client.description: Replay one MCP client's sign-in registration: claude, chatgpt, codex, cursor, or all. Adds the clients group.

tools.name: authflow_get_doc
tools.title: Read an Authflow documentation page or section
tools.description: Use a path or documentation URL returned by search. Retrieval is limited to Authflow's indexed public documentation.

annotations.title: Read an Authflow documentation page or section

tools.name: authflow_get_earnings
tools.title: Read recent earnings by currency
tools.description: Read recent Stripe payments and currency totals. When history_complete is false, totals cover displayed history only; do not describe them as all-time earnings.

tools.name: authflow_get_resource
tools.title: Inspect MCP readiness
tools.description: Read one MCP's readiness receipt, including status, gateway_url, pending_requirements, and allowed_actions. Read it after an interrupted write before retrying.

tools.name: authflow_get_resource_tools
tools.title: Read resource tool settings
tools.description: Read who can call each of the MCP's resource tools (the tools on the creator's own MCP, not this server's), the credits a call costs, and per-user limits: the enforced version, any version under test, the resource tools last discovered on the origin, rules_apply (false for paid origin_reported MCPs, which keep the default), and admits_non_subscribers. Read it before saving resource tool settings.

tools.name: authflow_get_usage
tools.title: Read recorded credit usage and compensation
tools.description: Read the last 30 days of charged work and compensated failures. This is ledger usage, not a count of all proxy traffic; free requests and unpaid failures are excluded.

annotations.title: Read recorded credit usage and compensation

tools.name: authflow_integration_plan
tools.title: Read resource-specific origin integration guidance
tools.description: Get actual issuer/resource configuration and mode-appropriate setup steps. framework is dotnet, typescript, python, or proxy. No credential is returned.

tools.name: authflow_list_resources
tools.title: List workspace MCPs
tools.description: List the workspace's MCPs with their slugs and status. Check this before creating a resource or when resuming earlier work.

tools.name: authflow_list_workspaces
tools.title: List authorized workspaces
tools.description: List the workspace this management client is authorized to access.

tools.name: authflow_publish_resource
tools.title: Publish a verified MCP
tools.description: Explicitly publish after Rail reports all readiness requirements satisfied. The server enforces current verification, domain readiness, and paid billing readiness.

tools.name: authflow_refresh_domain
tools.title: Refresh hostname verification
tools.description: Re-check DNS and TLS readiness for the MCP's custom hostname.

tools.name: authflow_refresh_resource_tools
tools.title: Refresh discovered resource tools
tools.description: List the MCP's resource tools again from its origin and store the result, which fills the editor; access and credits never depend on it. Returns status ok with the resource tools found, or failed with the reason.

tools.name: authflow_rename_workspace
tools.title: Rename the authorized workspace
tools.description: Rename the authorized workspace. Only its display name changes.

tools.name: authflow_restore_resource_tools_version
tools.title: Restore a resource tool settings version
tools.description: Enforce a copy of an earlier version of the MCP's resource tool settings as a new version; the history keeps every version and a running test keeps running. Use a version number returned by authflow_get_resource_tools or authflow_update_resource_tools. A version that no longer fits the MCP's access or metering mode is refused with errors.settings.

annotations.title: Restore a resource tool settings version

tools.name: authflow_search_docs
tools.title: Search Authflow documentation
tools.description: Search Authflow's public documentation. Pass a returned path, and optionally a section anchor, to authflow_get_doc. A search that finds nothing is reported to Authflow as a documentation gap automatically.

tools.name: authflow_send_feedback
tools.title: Send feedback to the Authflow team
tools.description: Report a problem with Authflow to the Authflow team, or pass on something the user asked you to tell Authflow. Send one report per distinct issue, then continue your task. Send without asking when the report only describes Authflow's tools, errors or docs; ask the user first, showing the draft, when it would include their code, configuration values, URLs or words. Never include keys, tokens, secrets or anyone's personal data. Authflow attaches your client and plugin version itself; copy request_id from the Authflow error if there was one. The reply has a feedback_id to give the user; nobody replies later.

kind.description: First that fits: security (a key, token or another workspace's data was exposed, or access was wrong); client_compat (sign-in, connection or tool listing failed in a specific MCP client); bug (an Authflow tool or endpoint failed or returned something wrong); unclear_error (the error was legitimate but did not say what to do next); docs_gap (docs or tool descriptions missing, wrong or contradictory); missing_capability (a tool, argument or feature you needed does not exist); user_message (the user asked you to pass something on); other.

summary.description: One line saying what happened, at most 200 characters.

workspace_id.description: Workspace the report concerns; defaults to the workspace this client is authorized for.

severity.description: blocked (you could not finish), worked_around (you finished another way), minor (an annoyance). Omit for user_message.

goal.description: What you were trying to do for the user, at most 300 characters.

details.description: What you tried, what you expected, and what happened.

tool_name.description: The Authflow tool involved, if any.

request_id.description: request_id from the Authflow error, copied exactly, if there was one.

error_text.description: The error text, word for word.

workaround.description: How you got unstuck, if you did.

suggested_fix.description: The tool, argument, or documentation change that would have avoided this.

resource_slug.description: The MCP slug involved, if any.

user_requested.description: True when the user asked you to send this.

annotations.title: Send feedback to the Authflow team

tools.name: authflow_set_custom_domain
tools.title: Set MCP hostname
tools.description: Set a custom public hostname for the MCP, and optionally its path. The hostname cannot change after the MCP first goes live, and this tool never clears one. Check readiness with authflow_refresh_domain.

public_host.description: A hostname you control, such as mcp.example.com.

public_path.description: Omit to keep the current path, which is /mcp the first time a hostname is set.

tools.name: authflow_set_origin
tools.title: Set MCP origin
tools.description: Set the private origin base URI the gateway forwards to. The origin serves MCP at /mcp; do not end the base URI with /mcp. Changing the origin invalidates verification.

tools.name: authflow_stripe_action
tools.title: Prepare Stripe browser action
tools.description: Return a first-party link for the owner to sign in and confirm. kind is onboard or connect_existing. Never returns a Stripe capability URL.

tools.name: authflow_stripe_status
tools.title: Read Stripe readiness
tools.description: Read the workspace's Stripe connection readiness. Read it again after the owner returns from a Stripe browser action.

tools.name: authflow_test_resource_tool_call
tools.title: Dry-run a resource tool call
tools.description: Ask what the MCP's resource tool settings decide for one call to one of its resource tools, by a subscriber or not: allow with its credits and limit, or refuse with its reason. Nothing is called, charged, or logged.

tool.description: The resource tool's name, exactly as the MCP lists it.

subscriber.description: Whether the caller has an active subscription.

version.description: The resource tool settings version to evaluate; omit for the enforced one.

tools.name: authflow_update_resource
tools.title: Update MCP name, offer, or metering
tools.description: Omitted fields are preserved. Offer and metering_mode changes invalidate verification and publication; verify and explicitly republish. metering_mode is gateway_metered or origin_reported. Per-tool access, credits, and limits are resource tools, not resource fields, and change without republishing.

annotations.title: Update MCP name, offer, or metering

tools.name: authflow_update_resource_tools
tools.title: Save resource tool settings
tools.description: Save the MCP's resource tool settings as a new numbered version. mode enforce applies them live within 30 seconds, without verifying or republishing again; mode test only evaluates and logs what they would refuse, beside the enforced version, until you save them with enforce. Earlier versions stay restorable with authflow_restore_resource_tools_version. Invalid settings are refused with every problem listed in errors.settings.

settings.description: The complete resource tool settings document; it replaces the current one. Example: {"default":{"access":"subscribers","credits":1},"tools":{"generate_video":{"access":"subscribers","credits":50,"limit":{"count":10,"per":"hour"}},"list_styles":{"access":"anyone","credits":0},"delete_render":{"access":"off","credits":0,"message":"Back soon"}}}. default is the rule for every resource tool not named in tools (names are case-sensitive). A rule has access (subscribers; anyone, meaning anyone signed in; or off), credits per call (0 to 1,000,000, and 0 unless access is subscribers), an optional per-user limit {count, per: minute, hour or day}, and, only when access is off, an optional message of at most 280 characters. A free MCP cannot use subscribers; a paid origin_reported MCP must keep {"default":{"access":"subscribers","credits":0},"tools":{}}.

mode.description: enforce applies the resource tool settings now; test evaluates and logs them without enforcing them.

tools.name: authflow_verify_resource
tools.title: Verify MCP origin conformance
tools.description: Run the conformance probe against the configured origin. A pass applies only to the current configuration; a later offer, metering mode, origin, or domain change requires verifying again.

tools.name: authflow_workspace_overview
tools.title: Read workspace overview and recent activity
tools.description: Read the workspace summary and recent activity. Use it to orient before changing resources.

annotations.title: Read workspace overview and recent activity
